name: Protoline Inc
old_description: Established in 1987, Protoline, Inc. is the largest manufacturer of circuit board in the Houston, TX area producing up to 20 layer boards. Our 20,000-sq.ft. (and growing) state of the art facility is capable of processing over 1,000 18″x24″ PWB or PCB panels per day. Company is ISO9001-2008 Certified, UL Certified, ITAR Registered and Minority Owned Business.
about:
Protoline Inc. was founded in 1987 by Paresh Jasani and Hitesh Jasani in Houston, Texas. The minority-owned company began after the founders gained experience in the printed circuit board manufacturing business.

The company operates a 20,000-square-foot facility certified to ISO 9001:2008, UL 94 V-0, and ITAR, capable of processing more than 1,000 18-by-24-inch panels per day. It produces single-sided, double-sided, and multilayer boards up to 20 layers, using substrates such as FR-4, FR-5, polyimide, and Teflon. Services include PCB layout and design, ECAD, design-for-manufacturability review, through-hole and surface-mount assembly, rigid-flex and flexible circuits, electrical testing, and full turnkey contract manufacturing with wire harness and box-build options. Quick-turn orders can ship in one to ten days, while standard lead time is about three weeks.

Protoline serves a range of industries including contract manufacturing, oil and gas, telecommunications, medical devices, data processing, recorders, controllers, audio, video, and aerospace.

The founders emphasize quality, on-time delivery, and competitive pricing, with a focus on design-to-manufacture support to avoid production issues.
